route: Entry/Temporary Residence and Work Permit for artists (Civil Registry and Migration Department)

permit.applies: The employer: first to the District Labour Office with the vacancy (a labour market test), then, on the Labour Department's positive answer, for the entry and residence permit to the Civil Registry and Migration Department or through the District Aliens and Immigration Unit of the Police (the EU portal's general route for employed workers; the CRMD's own artists' page was not reached).
permit.first: A letter of approval from the Department of Labour, and a ten-year bank guarantee for repatriation.

fees.what: Entry, residence and work permit for employment, up to 6 months
Registration in the aliens' register, first registration
Bank guarantee for repatriation, ten years (national of the U.S.A., Canada, China, India, Brazil and most countries)

permit.feesNote: The guarantee is EUR 550 for Russia, Ukraine and the other European countries listed, EUR 350 for Israel, Lebanon, Egypt, Turkey, the Gulf and the others listed; the entry permit for up to 3 months needs no registration.
permit.processingNote: The Migration Department's stated examination time for a complete application in the non-single-permit route.
permit.exemptNote: None: anyone entering to work needs an entry permit, whoever the employer and whatever the job; only tourist representatives and journalists are spared it.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Employed worker – Cyprus
sources.said: Initially the employer applies to the … District Labour Offices … Department of Labour- Ministry of Labour and Social Insurance … with a job vacancy. A labour market test is carried out to evaluate whether there are no suitably qualified local or European workers to fill the particular job vacancy. … Following the above, the employer submits an application for an entry and residence permit for the non-EU national to the … Civil Registry and Migration Department … or through the District Aliens and Immigration Units of the Police.

sources.title: Deputy Ministry of Migration and International Protection, Migration Department: Employment – other cases (non-single permit – NSP), posted 31 December 2025
sources.said: In order for a third-country national to enter the Republic for work purposes, no matter who the employer will be and the kind of job, the third-country national is obliged to obtain an entry permit as per the provisions of the Legislation . Tourist representatives and Journalists/Reporters are excluded from the procedure for an entry permit … Stamps and Fees: Entry permit for employment for a period up to 3 months (Registration in the aliens’ register is not required): €50 Entry permit, residence and work permit for a period of 3 to 6 months: €50 Residence and work permit for a period up to 12 months: €50 Registration in the aliens registry (only in cases of first registration): €70 Examination time of an application The examination of an application and the issuance of a temporary residence and work permit is completed within three months. … Duration of residence permit The duration of a temporary residence and work permit should not exit the period of one year.

sources.title: Migration Department, General employment: supporting documents, entry permit and temporary work permit for up to 3 months (December 2025)
sources.said: GENERAL EMPLOYMENT ENTRY PERMIT AND TEMPORARY WORK PERMIT FOR UP TO 3 MONTHS 1 Application Form MNSP3. 2 Copy of a valid passport … 3 Letter of approval from the Department of Labour. 4 Original letter of bank guarantee, of ten years duration, to cover possible repatriation costs.

sources.title: Migration Department, Bank guarantee: validity and amount by country of origin (posted 2 January 2026)
sources.said: The bank guarantee should be valid for at least ten (10) years. … The amount of the guarantee that should be submitted depends on the country of origin of the third country national … 211. U.S.A ΑΜΕΡΙΚΗ 850 … 103. RUSSIAN FEDERATION ΕΥΡΩΠΗ 550 … 195. ISRAEL ΑΣΙΑ 350
